title: Unavailable workspace retry budget
description: Real read-only inspection failures retain unknown status while unchanged retries are bounded; isolated authenticated dispatch proof follows.

retry-budget.intent: Eight unchanged unavailable checkouts stay unverified over630 logical seconds. Require no more than88 managed shells and176 actual Git launches; tear down the owned child and fixture.

dispatch-smoke.intent: Authenticated run.create reaches write-task, prepare and dispatch, then cancellation releases the owned fixture. Supply FARMSLOT_CLI and a fresh FARMSLOT_SAFE_IDLE_PROOF_OUT; do not allocate a farm slot. TMPDIR must satisfy the normal heavy-write floor.
